# Install-AvmTool

## Synopsis

Install one, several, or all managed tools from avm.pins.

## Description

Routed by the dispatcher:
    avm tool install                        -> Install everything in the lock
    avm tool install terraform              -> Install just terraform
    avm tool install terraform bicep        -> Install both
    avm tool install --force terraform      -> Force-reinstall

Each install goes through the atomic stage->rename pipeline implemented
by Install-AvmToolFromPins: SHA256 verified before extraction, version
directory renamed atomically into place, and a '.verified' marker
written last so that interrupted installs are re-tried automatically.

PowerShell module packages and pinned dependencies additionally validate
their ZIP entries, root manifest and exact NuGet package identity.
A locally detected InvalidDataException while reading or extracting
a module ZIP permits one new download into a fresh staging directory.
Checksum, download, permission, metadata and import failures do not
qualify for this archive retry. Pins and source restrictions remain
unchanged; no floating or prerelease package selection is introduced.

## CLI commands

- `avm tool install`

## Syntax

```powershell
Install-AvmTool [[-Name] <string[]>] [-Force] [-PinsPath <string>] [-Path <string>] [-AllowFileUrls] [-SkipModuleVersionCheck] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## Parameters

### -AllowFileUrls

Test-only escape hatch (see Test-AvmPins). Hidden from help
and tab-completion so it does not appear in the production surface.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `Switch` |
| Required | false |
| Position | named |
| Default value | False |
| Accept pipeline input | false |
| Accept wildcard characters | false |

### -Force

Reinstall even if the cache already has a '.verified' entry for the
requested version. The replacement is validated before removing that entry.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `Switch` |
| Required | false |
| Position | named |
| Default value | False |
| Accept pipeline input | false |
| Accept wildcard characters | false |

### -Name

One or more tool names from the lock. When omitted, every tool in
the lock is installed.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `String[]` |
| Required | false |
| Position | 1 |
| Default value |  |
| Accept pipeline input | false |
| Accept wildcard characters | false |

### -Path

Module root whose tool-version-overrides.json applies. Bicep monorepos
use their recognized repository root. Defaults to the current directory.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `String` |
| Required | false |
| Position | named |
| Default value | $PWD.Path |
| Accept pipeline input | false |
| Accept wildcard characters | false |

### -PinsPath

Override the bundled Resources/avm.pins.jsonc. Intended for tests.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `String` |
| Required | false |
| Position | named |
| Default value |  |
| Accept pipeline input | false |
| Accept wildcard characters | false |

### -SkipModuleVersionCheck

Skip the PowerShell Gallery check that otherwise stops the command when a
newer Avm.Authoring version is available. Writes a warning once.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `Switch` |
| Required | false |
| Position | named |

| Accept pipeline input | false |
| Accept wildcard characters | false |

## Examples

### EXAMPLE 1

```powershell
avm tool install terraform bicep
```

### EXAMPLE 2

```powershell
Install-AvmTool -Name PSRule, PSRule.Rules.Azure -Path $modulePath
```

## Outputs

- `One pscustomobject per tool or dependency with Name, Version, Platform,
Path and Action. Action identifies installation or reuse of the cache.`
